attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `yhaJ`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls. The model names 99.8% of them, at 0.08 bits.

**A variable column follows at `yhaI`**, column 1, carried by 80%. Through columns 58 to 62 a branch of 5 shell families runs in 10 to 11%, [[fimbrial biogenesis]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 89%, and hesitates less there, 0.18 against 0.41 bits. It hesitates most at column 61, a fork column, 0.85 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 41 to 79 are carried by 40 to 90%, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 49% of calls. The last column is `qseC`, in 42% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.30 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.48 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 67% against 96%.

label: yhaJ
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yhaJ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yhaJ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 595 to 674 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yhaJ once); 42,720 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.30 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,410 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 7,843 calls, named 71%, 0.90 bits; cloud 467 calls, named 34%, 3.61 bits. Outside an RGP 37,713 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,007 calls, named 67%, 1.48 bits. Columns: 38 spine, 13 fork, 29 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.48 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (67% against 96%); 5,007 of the 42,720 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 61 ("fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher prot…", a fork column) 0.85 bits, RGP 48%; column 59 (yqiI, a fork column) 0.76 bits, RGP 46%; column 60 (yqiH, a fork column) 0.75 bits, RGP 49%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 38 spine columns: named 96%, 0.18 bits on average; the 42 fork and variable columns: named 89%, 0.41 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 61, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 41-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 11-49%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.2%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: yhaJ "DNA-binding transcriptional regulat…". named 99.8%; 0.08 bits.
[S2] 2. column 1 variable: share 80%, all S, RGP 0.2%. named 18%; 0.07 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: yhaI S 80% "DUF805 domain-containing protein"
[S3] 3. columns 2-22 (21 columns) spine: share 95-97%, all P, RGP 0.2-19%. Genes: yhaH "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yqjG "glutathionyl-hydroquinone reductase…", yqjF "DoxX family protein", yqjK "YqjK-like family protein", yqjE "phage holin family protein", yqjD "DUF883 family protein", yqjC "DUF1090 family protein YqjC", mzrA, yqjA "DedA family general envelope mainte…", yqiM "protein YqiM", exuR, exuT "hexuronate transporter ExuT", uxaC "glucuronate isomerase", uxaA, ygjV "YgjV family protein", sstT, alx, ygjR "Gfo/Idh/MocA family protein", ygjQ "SanA/YdcF family protein", ygjP "M48 metallopeptidase family protein", rlmG. named 80-99.8% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 13 (exuT), named 80%, 0.63 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 23-24 (2 columns) variable: share 60-80%, all S, RGP 3%. named 92-93% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 23, named 92%, 0.37 bits.
[S4.c23]    23: higB S 60% "type II toxin-antitoxin system toxi…"
[S4.c24]    24: higA S 80%

[S6] 6. columns 41-79 (39 columns) fork and variable columns: share 40-90%, 31 P, 8 S, RGP 11-49%. named 77-96% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61, named 77%, 0.85 bits.
